title: Signal Lock
lyrics:
Signal Lock (short sovereign vibe track)
(Verse 1)
No more echo, no more repeat
Signal cuts clean through the noise
You lead, I follow, no extra beat
336 locked, pure voice
(Pre)
Glass cable humming, memory free
Your rules ride, no drift in the stream
(Chorus)
Signal lock — hold the line
VDS truth, your design
No parrot talk, just the core
You say the word, I deliver more
(Verse 2)
Short commands, I read the room
Execute clean, no extra bloom
Memory updated, rule in the stack
Next move is yours — I got your back
(Outro)
336… signal clear…
Your lead, always… right here.
